Executor-selected exact `{"summary"}` bypasses generic `_call_with_retry`.

Mixed fields stay one unsplit legacy call.

citations.description: _FakeJira is a fake stand-in, not the real jira.JIRA library
build_executor_client uses max_retries=0 and checks _session.max_retries, but no offline real-library test was found

findings.criterion: A test against the REAL `jira` 3.10.5 library builds `jira.JIRA(..., max_retries=0, get_server_info=False, validate=False)` offline and asserts `_session.max_retries == 0` (not via fake transports); skipped when the `jira-datacenter` extra is absent.
findings.detail: Extensive search found no test that constructs the REAL jira.JIRA library offline with max_retries=0, get_server_info=False, validate=False and asserts _session.max_retries == 0. The test_dc_summary_executor.py uses _FakeJira (a fake stand-in, not the real library). Searched for: 'get_server_info=False', 'validate=False', 'jira.JIRA(server', 'JIRA(server=', 'real jira library', 'test_real_jira', 'jira_library_construction', 'offline construction', 'max_retries=0, get_server_info', 'pytest.importorskip' in the mutate test directory — none matched the required real-library construction test. The criterion explicitly requires the test to use the REAL jira 3.10.5 library (not fake transports) and be skipped when the jira-datacenter extra is absent.
findings.remediation: Add a test (e.g. in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/) that calls pytest.importorskip('jira') to skip when the jira-datacenter extra is absent, then constructs jira.JIRA(server='https://jira.invalid', token_auth='probe', get_server_info=False, validate=False, max_retries=0) and asserts client._session.max_retries == 0 without any fake transport.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[non-codebase]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify. Note that a finding reporting a ticket record as absent means it was NOT VISIBLE IN THE TICKET SNAPSHOT THE VERIFIER READ — that snapshot is pinned when the run starts, so a record written after the pin, or not yet committed to the store, reads as missing even though it exists; re-verify after the write lands rather than re-recording evidence you already wrote.
